changelog: Merged the critic's candidate_rules into [When to Segment] as concise, surface-decidable checks that flag risky patterns ('class' labels, parenthetical name/acronym spans, numeric dates, gerund-without-object, 'between X and Y' ranges, coordinated name+location patterns, 'the first time that ...') so these positions are treated as risky candidates rather than blindly trusted.

Added narrowly-targeted demotions in [Priority Rules] (low-confidence tier) to lower rank for boundaries matching the above risky patterns (parenthetical-adjacent names, 'class' labels, date-year commas, V-ing with likely pending object, 'between ... and ...' ranges, 'the first time' + that-clause), while preserving candidacy.

Updated [Decision Procedure] ranking step to check these surface patterns with a local 1–6 token lookahead and either demote or (where the pattern is unambiguous and always unsafe) forbid the candidate; specifically moved the verb+immediate-object split and coordinated 'X in A and Y in B' name-location fragmentation into [Never Segment] as positions that must not be marked.
